inclusion: Participants are patients with Wilson disease (any age or disease stage)
The study drug is D-penicillamine, trientine, tetrathiomolybdate or zinc salts
The study has a control group (placebo, no treatment, or another treatment that does not include the study drug)
Prospective or retrospective controlled study (randomised or non-randomised trial, or comparative observational study)
exclusion: Case report, case series, cross-sectional study, before-after study, review or letter
